issues.description: Project/exercise name is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) title at line 1 is "H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon", while template_repository/settings.gradle defines rootProject.name = 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House' (line 1) and solution_repository/settings.gradle defines rootProject.name = 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution' (line 1). These three different names for the same exercise/project can confuse students about which repository and exercise they should work on.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the project/exercise name across all artifacts. Either update both settings.gradle files to use the problem statement title (e.g. rootProject.name = 'H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon') or update the problem statement title to match the repository names. Ensure the template and solution repositories use the same rootProject.name so students are not confused about which exercise they are implementing.
